subject: Spell Charges
text: Each spell level has a counter of available charges, allowing a spell of that level to be cast once per remaining charge.

evidence.quote:
SPELL CHARGE - each SL has a counter associated with it telling you how many
	spell charges remain that are available for use.  For each charge
	remaining you may cast a spell of that level one time

subject: Basic Stats
text: Basic stats consist of Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Vitality, and Luck, and they are not affected by equipment.

evidence.quote:
BASIC STATS - the statistics peculiar to each warrior which can be viewed on
	the left side of the status screen: S, G, I, V, L.  These stats are
	not affected by equipment

subject: Class Promotion
text: Promotion is a class change that all party members receive simultaneously at a unique point in the game.

evidence.quote:
PROMOTION - a change of class which all warriors recieve simultaneously at a
	unique point in the game, i.e. (Fi->Kn), (Wm->Wz), etc...

subject: Maximum Hit Points
text: During a strong level up, maximum hit points increase by 20 plus a quarter of Vitality plus a random value between 1 and 6, while a weak level up increases maximum hit points by a quarter of Vitality plus 1.

evidence.quote:
there are two types of level ups: weak and strong.
For a strong level up, MHP goes up by 20+[V/4]+(1..6).
For a weak level up, MHP goes up by [V/4]+1

subject: Level Up Experience
text: The maximum attainable level in Final Fantasy is level 50.

subject: Spell Charges
text: The Fighter, Thief, Black Belt, and Master classes have no innate capacity for casting magic.

evidence.quote: The Fi/Th/Bb/Ma classes have no capacity for magic

subject: Random Encounters
text: A random battle counter starts between 50 and 255, decrementing by 6 per step on outside terrain, 5 per step in monster lairs, and 2 per step on a ship until reaching a negative value.

evidence.quote:
at the beginning of the previous combat, a random number x is generated where
x = (50..255).  for each step taken

-outside on desert,plains,forest,marsh,river	decrement x by 6
-inside of a cave,or other monster lair		decrement x by 5
-outside on a ship				decrement x by 2
-on a damage square in a monster lair, in
  the airship, in a seaport, or inside		leave x alone

when x<0, battle begins.

subject: World Map
text: The world map is a 256 by 256 grid subdivided into 64 distinct 32 by 32 enemy domains.

evidence.quote:
the world map in FF1 is a grid 256 units wide by 256 units tall.  Label each
square on this map using X,Y pseudo-cartesian coordinates: (0,0) is the first
grid sqare in the NW-most corner,  (0,255) is the square in the SW-most
corner, (255,255) is the square in the SE-most corner, etc...

the entire world map is subdivided into 64 smaller (32x32) domains

subject: Damage
text: Base values for derived stat D are determined as [S/2] for Fi/Kn/Wm/Wz/Th/Ni/Rm/Rz, [(S+1)/2] for Bm/Bz/(armed Bb/Ma), and LV x 2 for unarmed Bb/Ma.

evidence.quote:
- - - - - - HOW THE BASE VALUES FOR DERIVED STATS ARE DETERMINED: - - - - - -...D = [S/2]	for Fi/Kn/Wm/Wz/Th/Ni/Rm/Rz
  = [(S+1)/2]	for Bm/Bz/(armed Bb/Ma)*
  = LV x 2	for unarmed Bb/Ma

subject: Hit Percentage
text: Base values for derived stat H% are (initial value at LV 1) + (3 x (LV-1)) for Fi/Kn/Bb/Ma, + (2 x (LV-1)) for Th/Ni/Rm/Rz, and + (LV - 1) for Wm/Wz/Bm/Bz.

evidence.quote:
- - - - - - HOW THE BASE VALUES FOR DERIVED STATS ARE DETERMINED: - - - - - -...H% = (initial value at LV 1) + (3 x (LV-1)) for Fi/Kn/Bb/Ma
   = (initial value at LV 1) + (2 x (LV-1)) for Th/Ni/Rm/Rz
   = (initial value at LV 1) + (LV - 1) for Wm/Wz/Bm/Bz

subject: Absorb
text: Base values for derived stat A are determined as 0 for all classes, except LV for a bare Bb/Ma.

evidence.quote:
- - - - - - HOW THE BASE VALUES FOR DERIVED STATS ARE DETERMINED: - - - - - -...A = 0		for all classes, except...
  = LV		for a bare Bb/Ma*

subject: Evade Percentage
text: Base values for derived stat E% are determined as G + 48% for all classes.

evidence.quote: - - - - - - HOW THE BASE VALUES FOR DERIVED STATS ARE DETERMINED: - - - - - -...E% = G + 48%	for all classes

subject: Initial Stats
text: Initial values of H% and MHP stats are 10 and 35 for Fi/Kn, 5 and 33 for Bb/Ma, 5 and 28 for Wm/Wz, 5 and 25 for Bm/Bz, 5 and 30 for Th/Ni, and 7 and 30 for Rm/Rz.

evidence.quote:
The
H% and MHP rows tell you what the initial values of those stats are for that
particular class...	Class 	Fi/Kn	Bb/Ma	Wm/Wz	Bm/Bz	Th/Ni	Rm/Rz...H%		10	5	5	5	5	7
 MHP		35	33	28	25	30	30

text: For Kn, SL charges in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 are nothing at <(+1) and reach 4 4 4 0 0 0 0 0 at >(+6).
